title: Minimum Cost to Make Two Binary Strings Equal
summary: Make equal-length binary strings s and t identical at minimum cost. Allowed operations: flip one bit in either string for flipCost; swap two distinct positions within either one string for swapCost; exchange s[i] and t[i] at the same index for crossCost. Operations may be repeated in any order.
officialConstraints: String length 1 through 100000; each cost is a positive integer at most 1000000000; strings contain only 0 and 1.
pitfalls: Cross-string swaps must use the same index. Within-string swaps can use any two distinct indices. Both strings may change.
